|     <style>
|       "		
			body, button, input, textarea, select {  font-family: "Open Sans", "Segoe UI",  sans-serif;  }
			body, input, select, button {  font-size: 13px;  }
			
			body {  margin:0;  background:#111418;  background-image: radial-gradient(52% 57% at 75% 12%, rgba(255, 90, 210, 0.23), transparent 72%), radial-gradient(45% 48% at 53% 43%, rgba(0, 190, 255, 0.18), transparent 72%), radial-gradient(45% 55% at 21% 21%, rgba(255, 170, 20, 0.19), transparent 72%);  }
			#cap { 
				font-size:1.2em;
				color:#e6e6e6;
				user-select:text;
			}
			#cap #ccont {  padding:0 2% 1em 2%;   }
			#cap a { color:inherit;  font-weight:bold;  }
			#cap p { margin-bottom:1.5em;  line-height:1.5em;  }
			#cap button {  color:white;  font-weight:bold;  background-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); cursor:pointer; font-size:1.3em; padding:0.7em 1.3em 0.8em 1.3em;  border-radius:500px;  display:block;  margin:30px auto;  transition: box-shadow .3s, background-color .3s;  }
			#cap button:hover {  box-shadow: 0 0 30px #3482f6;  background-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);  }
			#cap h1 { text-align:center;  font-size: 4em;  margin:0.5em 0 0 0;  }
			.pair img, .pair video {  border-radius:1.6em;  }
			
			#cap h1, #cap h2 {  letter-spacing: -0.03em;  }
			
			#mid {  max-width:1100px;  margin:0px auto;  }
			#bar {  padding:0.4em 0;  line-height:2.5em;  background:#111418;  padding:0.7em 2.5%;    }
			#bar a {  text-decoration:none;  font-weight:normal;  margin:0 10px;  bottom:4px;  position:relative;  }
			
			
			
			.pair {  display:flex;  margin:3em 0;  }
			.pair div {  width:50%;  }
			.pair h2 {  margin:0;  }
			
			@media (max-width: 600px) {
			.pair {  display:block;  margin:3em 1em;  }
			.pair div {  width:100%;  }
			}
			
			.pair p {  margin: 0.2em 0;  opacity:0.6;  }
			.pair div {padding: 1em 0;}
		"

|     <script>
|       "
			window.___osw = window.innerWidth;  console.log(window.innerWidth);
			var cap = document.getElementById("cap"), added=false;
			var href = window.location.href;
			var ls = window.localStorage, ppp=null;  if(ls) {  ppp=ls.getItem("_ppp");  if(ppp) ppp=JSON.parse(ppp);  }  if(ppp==null) ppp={};
			
			function addPP() {
				cap.style.display="none";  
				if(ppp) {  ppp["capShown"]="false";  ls.setItem("_ppp", JSON.stringify(ppp));   }
				if(added) return;  added=true;  console.log("adding");
				var fls = [
					"style/all10.css",
					"code/ext/ext1792610350.js",
					"code/dbs/DBS1792677468.js",
					"code/pp/pp1792675746.js"
				];
				var fromCDN = false;  //window.location.host=="www.photopea.com" && !window.location.href.endsWith("nocdn");
				var ao = window.location.ancestorOrigins;
				if(ao) for(var i=0; i<ao.length; i++) if(ao[i].indexOf("figma.com")!=-1) fromCDN=false;
				
				for(var i=0; i<fls.length; i++) {
					var url = (fromCDN?"//vecpea.com/":"")+fls[i], isJS = url.endsWith(".js");
					var el = document.createElement(isJS ? "script" : "link");
					el.setAttribute(isJS ? "src" : "href",url);
					if(!isJS) el.setAttribute("rel","stylesheet");
					else el.async=false;
					
					(isJS ? document.body : document.head).appendChild(el);
				}
			}
			
			if(href.indexOf("#")!=-1 || href.indexOf("=")!=-1 || ppp["capShown"]=="false") addPP();
			else {
				cap.style.display="";	
				window.addEventListener("load", function () {  var v = document.getElementById("goats");  v.src = "img/goats.mp4";  v.play();  });
				if(Math.random()<0.1) {
					fetch("//www.photopea.com/papi/event.php?id=fst_Visit");
					window.__otime = Date.now();
					window.addEventListener("unload", function(e) {
						if((Date.now()-window.__otime)<10000 && ppp && ppp["capShown"]!="false") fetch("//www.photopea.com/papi/event.php?id=fst_Left");  // User left in less than 10 seconds without clicking on "Start using Photopea"
					});
				}
			}				
		"
